search_window.note: Bounded approximately one-hour recall interval based on the hourly schedule. Search indexing may lag; publication-time verification required for any later discovery.

coverage_notes: Completed exactly 12 targeted web searches on 2026-10-09, covering the four high-value miss classes: sole/last/full-service grocery loss; disaster-canceled food distributions; abrupt food pantry/bank closure or major service reductions; and immediately consequential official SNAP/WIC interruptions. No new qualifying, verifiably fresh signal identified. Excluded older grocery fires/closures (Spencer, NY, 2026-09-11; Akron, OH, 2026-05-30), routine open pantry schedules, and unrelated retail closures. Official severe-weather WIC/health-office closures in Mississippi and Florida appeared again but were previously identified in earlier recall checks (Jackson County, MS; Bay and Washington Counties, FL) and were not counted twice. Search results did not substantiate a newly announced SNAP benefit outage or new canceled emergency-food distribution in this bounded interval. Public search indexing and publication timestamps are imperfect; no claim of exhaustive nationwide coverage. Primary production collection remains authoritative. No approvals, publications, schedule changes, or production actions.
